metadata.description: Static security audit findings for EIP-specific checks (batch 10)

input_validation_bypass.finding: Authorization list presence validated at line 404-410. Empty auth list rejected with ErrEmptyAuthList. Each authorization validated individually via validateAuthorization().

race_conditions.finding: Single-threaded execution. Authorization nonce checked atomically (line 607). Nonce incremented in applyAuthorization (line 627).

phase5_confidence.justification: Sequential processing with individual validation. Signature verification uses standard ecrecover. Nonce prevents replay. Gas charged upfront.
